{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2013}}
{{main|2013 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2013 World Table Tennis Championships women's doubles''' was the 51st edition of the women's doubles championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Tennis}}</ref><ref name=ITTF>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsWD.pdf|title=Women's doubles results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120412045730/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsWD.pdf|archive-date=2012-04-12}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|title=Table Tennis World Championship medal winners|publisher=Sports123|access-date=2018-03-21|archive-date=2018-09-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180922055935/http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

[[Guo Yue (table tennis)|Guo Yue]] and [[Li Xiaoxia]] are the defending champions.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2190&Doubles=1 Entry list]</ref><br>
[[Guo Yue (table tennis)|Guo Yue]] and [[Li Xiaoxia]] defeated [[Ding Ning]] and [[Liu Shiwen]] 5–11, 11–5, 11–7, 11–5, 11–7 in the final to win the title.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=31626&Competition_ID=2190&|title=Champions in Yokohama and Rotterdam, Guo Yue and Li Xiaoxia Retain Title|date=2013-05-20|work=ittf.com}}</ref>

==Seeds==
Doubles matches will be best of 5 games in qualification matches and best of 7 games in the 64-player sized main draw.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2013/Playing_system_WTTC2013.pdf |title=2013 World TT Championships Playing System |publisher=ITTF |access-date=11 May 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2190&Seeded_Doubles=1&FormParticipants_Sorting=26&FormParticipants_Sorted=& |title=2013 WTTC Seeds&nbsp;– Women's doubles |work=ittf.com |access-date=11 May 2013 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130608193446/http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2190&Seeded_Doubles=1&FormParticipants_Sorting=26&FormParticipants_Sorted=& |archive-date=8 June 2013 }}</ref>
